project.title: Revenue Operations Automation for Northwind Coffee Co.
project.cover_subtitle: A 3-month engagement to replace manual bottlenecks with systems that recover revenue while you sleep.

situation.headline: You're leaving revenue on the table every day the ops stay manual.
situation.lede: Northwind is doing the hard part: you have a product people love and a loyal customer base that keeps reordering. But the infrastructure behind the brand is still stitched together with spreadsheets, copy-paste, and founder time. Every week that passes, compounding opportunities go quiet.
situation.callout_body: growing DTC brands don't die from lack of demand. They die from operational drag — the small, repeated tasks that eat founder attention and let revenue slip through unnoticed.
situation.close: This proposal outlines a focused engagement to remove the four biggest drags on your revenue engine and replace them with systems that run without you.

problems.title: Abandoned carts going cold
problems.body: Roughly 68% of carts are abandoned and your current recovery sequence is a single email sent six hours later. You're losing an estimated $8-12K per month in recoverable revenue because the flow isn't segmented by cart value, product, or whether the shopper has bought before.

problems.title: Wholesale inquiries stuck in your inbox
problems.body: Cafés and retailers email orders@ and wait three-plus days for a reply. You're the bottleneck. Deals worth $2K-$15K go cold because there's no intake form, no auto-reply with your wholesale deck, and no CRM capturing the lead before it disappears into Gmail.

problems.title: Subscription churn you can't see coming
problems.body: Subscribers cancel without warning. You have no signal for who's about to churn, no win-back flow, and no way to pause vs. cancel. Each lost subscriber is roughly $340 in lifetime value, and you're watching that number grow in Shopify with no lever to pull.

problems.title: Post-purchase silence
problems.body: After a customer buys, they hear from you once: the shipping notification. No brewing guide, no story, no reorder nudge, no review ask. You're skipping the highest-intent window in the customer lifecycle and it shows in your repeat-purchase rate sitting below industry benchmark.

benefits.title: Cart recovery that actually converts
benefits.body: A three-touch sequence segmented by cart value and customer type, triggered within 30 minutes. Conservative projection: recover 12-18% of abandoned carts, which on your volume translates to $6K-$10K in monthly revenue you're currently losing without noticing.

benefits.title: Wholesale pipeline on autopilot
benefits.body: A dedicated wholesale intake form, instant auto-reply with your deck and pricing tiers, and every inquiry landing in a CRM with clear ownership. You go from reactive inbox-checking to a pipeline where deals either close or get logged, nothing sits.

benefits.title: Churn signals you can act on
benefits.body: A churn-risk score per subscriber, a pause-instead-of-cancel flow, and a win-back sequence for the ones who leave anyway. Reducing churn by just 2 percentage points is roughly $15K in annual retained revenue on your current subscriber base.

benefits.title: Post-purchase that drives repeats
benefits.body: A five-touch post-purchase flow: shipping, brewing guide, origin story, review ask, reorder offer. Each touch tied to behavior, not just days. Target: lift repeat-purchase rate from current baseline to 32%+, the benchmark for specialty DTC coffee.

scope.m1_body: CRM setup, data audit, Shopify + Klaviyo integration, wholesale intake form + auto-reply, cart recovery v1 live by week 3.
scope.m2_body: Churn scoring model, pause/cancel flow, win-back sequence, post-purchase 5-touch flow, review engine tied to Yotpo.
scope.m3_body: A/B tests on every flow, performance dashboard, SOP documentation, 60-minute team training, 30-day post-engagement support.
scope.throughout: Weekly 30-min sync, Slack channel for async questions, all work in your accounts so nothing is locked to me.
scope.out_of_scope: Paid ads, creative/design production, new Shopify theme work. Happy to refer trusted partners.

investment.roi_title: Expected return in month one alone
investment.roi_body: from cart recovery and wholesale pipeline: $8K-$12K in otherwise-lost revenue. The engagement pays for itself before month two begins.

agreement.body: Signing below kicks off Month 1. First working session within 3 business days. You'll have cart recovery live and wholesale intake running before we bill Month 2.
